title: Budget-lane focusing in a setup configuration
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a\in\bbn$, and let $x$ be a finite word over the schedule alphabet. Take a base configuration on $x$ with $W.k+3$ work tapes and control phases parameterized by the state set of $W$ and by $a$. For optional control phases $q,q'$, an input-head position $p$, integers $b,u,g,z$, tape contents $bt,ut,gt:\bbz\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{OblSymbol})$, and finite lists $l,r$ of possibly blank schedule symbols, focusing the first of the three additional work tapes in the setup configuration determined by $q,p,b,u,g,bt,ut,gt$ at frontier $z$ with lists $l,r$ and state $q'$ gives the setup configuration determined by $q',p,z,u,g$, the zipper tape determined by $z,l,r$, and $ut,gt$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$x$ is a finite word over the schedule alphabet
The base configuration is on $x$ and has $W.k+3$ work tapes with the specified control-phase type
$p$ is an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions
$bt,ut,gt$ are functions from integers to possibly blank schedule symbols
$l,r$ are finite lists of possibly blank schedule symbols
replaced:
Take a setup configuration and focus its budget lane: replace the state by $q'$, the
budget tape by the zipper tape with frontier $z$, left list $l$, and right list $r$,
and move the budget head to $z$, keeping every other tape and head.  The result is
again a setup configuration, with the same base configuration, input head, unary and
guide data, state $q'$, budget head $z$, and budget tape given by that zipper.
